title: Cloud Service build.json
description: Configuration schema for cloud service build.json files used by the build.sh engine in ~/git/cloud/

category.description: Service category matching the directory prefix

domain.description: Public domain or path where the service is accessible (e.g. 'api.diegonmarcos.com/c3-api')

multi_vm.description: When true, this service is deployed to all VMs (deploy.host should be 'all')

on_demand.description: When true, service is launched by CI/orchestration on demand (cloud-builder-x pattern). Health reports treat `absent from docker ps` as Info, not Critical.

ports.description: Named port mappings for the service

host.description: SSH alias of the target VM, 'local' for local-only, or 'all' for multi-VM deployment

remote_path.description: Absolute path on the target VM where the service is deployed (empty string for local-only)

excludes.description: Glob patterns to exclude from rsync during deployment

compose_flags.description: Additional flags passed to 'docker compose up' (e.g. '--build')

sequential_restart.description: When true, restart containers one-by-one instead of all at once

terraform.description: When true, this service uses Terraform for deployment instead of Docker Compose

wrangler.description: When true, deploy via Cloudflare Wrangler CLI instead of SSH

include_cloud_data.description: When true, copy cloud-data/ generated configs into the build output

copy_only.description: When true, skip nix build and just copy src/ to dist/

extra_copy.description: Additional files/directories to copy from the service root into dist/

preserve_symlinks.description: When true, preserve symlinks during copy instead of dereferencing

escape_dollars.description: When true, escape dollar signs in decrypted secrets (needed for Docker Compose interpolation)

jwks_file.description: Source SOPS-encrypted JWKS key file name in src/

jwks_dest.description: Destination path for the decrypted JWKS key relative to dist/

pre_hook.description: Script to run on the VM before 'docker compose up' (relative to deploy path)

post_hook.description: Script to run on the VM after 'docker compose up' (relative to deploy path)

docker.description: Docker image build configuration (for services that build custom images)

proxy.description: Caddy reverse proxy configuration (consumed by caddy flake to generate Caddyfile routes)

upstream.description: Upstream address in format 'service.app:port' (resolved via Hickory DNS over WireGuard)

type.description: Routing type: 'path' for path-based routing under a parent domain, omit for dedicated domain

base_path.description: URL path prefix for path-based routing (e.g. '/c3-api')

paths.description: Per-path auth overrides (e.g. public endpoints within an authenticated service)

bypass_paths.description: URL path patterns that bypass authentication

landing_page.description: Front-end project name to use as the landing/redirect page

tls_skip_verify.description: When true, skip TLS certificate verification for upstream (e.g. self-signed certs)

streaming.description: When true, configure proxy for SSE/streaming responses (MCP servers)

l4_ports.description: Caddy L4 TCP port forwarding rules (for non-HTTP protocols like IMAP, SMTP)

comment.description: Human-readable label for the port mapping

api.description: Declarative API surface. Flows from build.json -> _cloud-data-consolidated.json (consolidator) -> services.<name>.api inside every per-container build-{name}.json (deriveServiceConnections). Each container reads only its own build-{containername}.json to introspect peers.

type.description: API style. 'no-api' = service has no programmatic interface and should be excluded from the registry.

spec_path.description: Path on the upstream that returns an OpenAPI/Swagger document (e.g. '/swagger.json', '/docs/json'). Used to build api_url at runtime.

spec_url.description: Absolute URL override for the OpenAPI document when hosted off-service. Takes precedence over spec_path.

base_path.description: Conventional API path prefix (e.g. '/api/v1', '/api'). For documentation and discovery; not used for routing.

endpoint_count.description: Number of distinct endpoints exposed. 0 if not enumerated; the registry can backfill this by inspecting the live spec.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the registry.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the API exposes.

auth.description: Authentication enforced by the upstream itself (NOT what Caddy/Authelia adds in front).

mcp.description: Declarative MCP (Model Context Protocol) surface. Flows from build.json -> services.<name>.mcp inside every per-container build-{name}.json. Describes the deployed/network-reachable transport — stdio-only services should still declare it (for catalogue completeness) and consumers filter on transport at read time.

transport.description: MCP transport actually exposed by the deployed container. stdio is for dev-only services not reachable over the network and should be excluded from the registry.

endpoint_path.description: URL path the MCP server listens on (e.g. '/mcp', '/sse').

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the registry.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the MCP exposes.

auth.description: Authentication enforced by the MCP server itself (NOT what Caddy/Authelia adds in front).

enabled.description: When true, include this service in automated backups

volumes.description: Docker volume names to include in backups

init_job.description: One-shot init container — health reports treat Exited (0) within depends_on start window as success, not crash

db_path.description: Path to sqlite/file DB inside the container

dump_cmd.description: Custom dump command (runs via docker exec)

frozen.description: When true, service is archived and not actively deployed

lifecycle.description: Custom lifecycle actions (wake/sleep/custom commands) for on-demand services

container.description: Docker container name for exec actions

script.description: Script path or command to execute inside the container

tfvars_template.description: Template file name for terraform.tfvars generation

hm.description: Home Manager deployment configuration (for b_infra/home-manager/ services)

user.description: Unix username on the target VM

remote_build.description: When true, rsync flake to VM and build on-machine (for cross-arch)
